heading: Sec. 201.01. - Short title.
text:
This chapter shall be known as the "Westchester County Administrative Code."

(§ 1 of the Laws of 1948, Ch. 852)

heading: Sec. 201.11. - Definitions.
text:
1.

Wherever used in this act, unless otherwise expressly stated, or unless the context
or subject matter otherwise requires:

a.

The term "county" shall mean the County of Westchester.

b.

The term "Charter" and "County Charter" shall mean the form of government for the
County of Westchester adopted November 2, 1937, pursuant to Chapter 617 of the Laws
of 1937, as amended.

c.

The term "County Board" shall mean the Board of Supervisors of the County of Westchester
as now existing, or other legislative governing body of the county hereafter created.

d.

The term "municipal corporation" or "municipality" shall mean or include the towns,
villages, cities and/or districts contained in the county as the context requires.

e.

The terms "real property", "real estate", "land" and "property" shall be construed
to signify and embrace all lands, improvements, structures, works and any facilities
in, over or under the same and/or rights derived therefrom, or appurtenant thereto,
including all rights and interests therein other or less than a fee title.

f.

The term "person" includes a natural person and also a public or private corporation,
the state and a political subdivision thereof, and any association, authority, commission,
board, board of managers or trustees in charge of or having control of any of the
charitable or other institutions of the state.

g.

The term "public purpose" or "county purpose" shall mean and include the term "public
use."

2.

All words and phrases contained in this act are used according to their accepted and
ordinary meaning except where another meaning is specifically indicated or manifest.
Words used in the singular number shall extend to and include the plural number, and
words used in the plural number shall extend to and include the singular number. Words
used in the masculine gender shall extend to and include the feminine.

(§ 2 of the Laws of 1948, Ch. 852)

heading: Sec. 205.01. - County of Westchester: territory, powers, obligations, etc.
text:
The County of Westchester as now existing shall continue under the same name and with
the same territory and boundaries, and the county shall have such powers and rights
and shall be subject to such obligations and liabilities as are in existence at the
effective date of this act and/or as may be hereafter lawfully granted or imposed.

(§ 3 of the Laws of 1948, Ch. 852)
